misc.text: #ONEPIECE #Eclipse Since this fits perfectly with the current global theme of the world... Xebec's sword is named "Eclipse," and Blackbeard himself possesses the Darkness-Darkness Fruit. I can easily imagine Blackbeard triggering a "pseudo-Eclipse" across the entire One Piece world, shrouding the globe in darkness and boosting his power by 100%... It would be his own "Domain Expansion", where he could possess infinite power, where he could simply nullify any Devil Fruit from anywhere. Perhaps Xebec had intended to use this power to counter Imu. That would be such an insane "Awakened" power move...
